text:
Maya (docs): Heads up — I'm drafting the release notes for next push. noticing two things: (1) the "compact" relnotes format drops SDK snippet line-wraps on mobile, and (2) a known issue where changelog permalinks for migrated pages return 404s after the anchor rewrite.
Sam (eng): ugh. can you show an example of the snippet wrap bug?
Maya (docs): yep. posted an example in the PR comments: ```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = client.generate('hi')
print(resp)
``` on desktop shows fine, mobile view concatenates lines into one long inline block. repro on iPhone and Android webview.
Eli (platform): I think that's the markdown-to-html sanitizer we added for compact cards. It strips line breaks in fenced blocks when compact=true. quick fix would be to preserve whitespace for ``` blocks or fall back to a small scrollable container.
Henry (devex): caret — that sanitizer change was to reduce card height but didn't account for code blocks. We can special-case fenced code when compact flag present. I can push a patch to the rendering lib.
Maya (docs): thanks. also the permalink 404s: during the anchor migration we changed slug+anchor shapes; old links redirected but the redirect table missed some legacy /docs/migrate/* paths. noticed in link-checker report: /docs/sdk-snippets#install -> 404 for a handful of pages.
Sam (eng): is there a quick redirect entry we can add to netlify/_redirects or whatever? we need this fixed before publishing the relnotes (we reference those anchors).
Eli (platform): we have a redirect table CSV in infra; I can add the missing rows and deploy a redirect-only patch. low risk.
Maya (docs): awesome. can we also update the relnotes template to include an inline note under Known issues for any anchor redirects we had to add? to be transparent.
Henry (devex): yes — suggest a short blurb: "Known issue: some legacy permalinks may return 404; we've added redirects and will monitor." keep it concise.
Maya (docs): perfect. last bit: the SDK snippet in the Python example uses the old import path. I'll add an edit to the snippet and a small example showing streaming. here's the patch text I plan to include in the relnotes: "Updated SDK snippets to use new `redwood.Client` import and added streaming example." ok to ship?
Sam (eng): fine with me. can you link the PRs so eng can review quickly?
Maya (docs): PRs: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/482 (relnotes edits), https://git.internal/redwood/platform/pull/751 (redirects), https://git.internal/redwood/render/pull/398 (sanitizer patch). please review.
docs-ci: build queued for refs/pull/482/head — running link-checker and snapshot tests.
Eli (platform): I'll review 398 now; if green I can merge and cut a deploy for the sanitizer fix. redirects and relnotes can land after.
deploy-bot: deploy started — preview site for refs/pull/398 at https://staging.redwood-inference.com/preview/398
Maya (docs): thanks everyone. timeline: aim to publish relnotes in 4h. if any blocker pops up ping me in this thread.
Sam (eng): thumbs up. I'll do a quick smoke on mobile once the sanitizer fix is live.
Maya (docs): noted. if link-checker reports failures after redirect deploy, I'll hold the release. otherwise proceed.
Eli (platform): merged render/398, sanitizer change live. preserving fenced code whitespace now.
docs-ci: link-checker passed for refs/pull/482, no remaining 404s in the report.
Maya (docs): green across the board. merging relnotes PR and tagging release branch.
Maya (docs): final note for release copy: include a short troubleshooting tip for customers: "If you see compact card code blocks collapsed in mobile, reload or view the full article — fix deployed 2026-03-21." (we can adjust date when we publish).
Henry (devex): added a tiny changelog entry in the render lib: "Preserve fenced code whitespace in compact relnotes cards."
Maya (docs): awesome, closing this thread. :tada:
